kanto.flavorText: The SHELLDER that latches onto SLOWPOKE’s tail is said to feed on the host’s leftover scraps.

original-johto.flavorText: An attached SHELLDER won't let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of its tail.

hoenn.flavorText: Its tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can’t be used for fishing anymore. This forces it to reluctantly swim and catch prey.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.

updated-johto.flavorText: Naturally dull to begin with, it lost its ability to feel pain due to SHELLDER’s seeping poison.

original-unova.flavorText: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.

updated-unova.flavorText: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.

kalos.flavorText: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Slowbro’s tail has a Shellder firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can’t be used for fishing anymore. This causes Slowbro to grudgingly swim and catch prey instead.

original-alola.flavorText: Whenever Shellder bites down hard on its tail, it gives Slowbro a flash of inspiration...which it forgets a moment later.

updated-alola.flavorText: Shellder, in its greed to suck out more and more sweetness from Slowbro’s tail, has metamorphosed into a spiral-shaped shell.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Lives lazily by the sea. If the Shellder on its tail comes off, it becomes a Slowpoke again.

swsh.flavorText: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.
